This table describes a selection of amendments to the U.S. Constitution.

Select Amendments to the U.S. Constitution

| Year Ratified | Amendment    | Description                                                                 |
|--------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1868         | Fourteenth   | Grants citizenship to all people born in the United States; protects equal process of the law |
| 1870         | Fifteenth    | Guarantees right to vote for all men                                         |
| 1920         | Nineteenth   | Extends right to vote for women                                             |
| 1961         | Twenty-third | Extends right to vote for residents of District of Columbia                 |
| 1971         | Twenty-sixth | Lowers the legal voting age from 21 to 18                                  |

Based on this table, which generalization can be made about constitutional amendments?

options.label: A
options.text: They primarily deal with topics that follow established procedures and traditions.

options.label: B
options.text: They primarily deal with topics relating to election cycles and limiting terms of office.

options.label: C
options.text: They play an important role in expanding participation in the democratic process.

options.label: D
options.text: They play an important role in expanding the power of publicly elected officials.
